content.summary: Investing.com -- Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) and Universal Corporation (NYSE:UVV) have filed the entertainment industry’s first major lawsuit against a generative AI company, accusing image generator Midjourney of large-scale copyright infringement. The studios allege Midjourney built its business by training on their intellectual property and enabling users to produce high-quality images of characters like Darth Vader, Elsa, Shrek, and the Minions... all without permission.
